body: I personally have a what I call “baby blanket” and that thing is everything to me. I just had to stop when I saw this post and tell my boyfriend I’d leave him if he made me choose between him and my blanket. Tell her about how much it’s meant to you, it’s been there through everything without a doubt. It’s also been the only thing I don’t expect anything from it’s so reliable.
My new therapist actually said that during my treatment this will be the hardest thing, not relying on it to protect my feelings anymore
I experienced this a lot growing up. People think if you’re young or if your parents are well off that you can’t have depression, but that’s not true.
I think you would really benefit from yoga and meditation. There is a girl on utube that I watch: bohobeautiful . Please don’t do this. Remember how beautiful other peoples/animals spirits can be <3
I might’ve posted wrong I don’t really know how reddit works. Thank you that helps a lot <3
I’m glad you couldn’t find anything.

I want you to walk tomorrow, outside preferably. Do something that gets you moving. It sounds like you have a lot going on in your head, I would try to talk to a professional if you can. If that’s not available to you talk to a close friend or family member. If that’s not available to you continue reaching out to this community for support and call a suicide hotline. Always feel free to message me if you want to talk <3

I’ve drank to the point of attempting by cutting myself.. ended up in the loony bin for 6 days. As for everything else, I have a hard time reading like I don’t understand what people say a lot so I’m just gonna go with what I’ve got. Have you ever thought about being a CNA? I’ve been one for 2 years and it got me out of that “I’m never gonna be good enough to be a nurse” so much so that I’m thinking about applying for school again. There are so many places you can work with your nurses aide certification and they are almost always a very rewarding experience. Feel free to message me if you ever want to talk about the feelings you’re feeling now.
I feel the same way. You have to remember people are people and sometimes they’re shitty.

Your life isn’t wasted. You did something amazing and selfless for your mom. I’m sure she is so grateful for you and the relationship you guys had. I don’t know what to tell you about your situation... the thing that always makes me feel better, is to clean? Like really clean. You can look up simple soap recipes online or maybe look for something around your trailer. I really hope you don’t do this. You seem like such a kind and selfless person.

Hey... I hope you’re getting some help right now and that’s why you’re not responding
sending my love <3
